query: select f.id, f.ext, f.original_name, f.size, f.width, f.height, f.has_thumbnail, f.views, u.username as uploader_username, to_char(f.created_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') as "created_at!", count(*) over() as "total!" from files f join unreferenced_files on file_id = f.id join users u on u.id = f.uploaded_by_user_id where f.status = 'available' order by case when $3 = 'created_at' and $4 then f.created_at end asc, case when $3 = 'created_at' and not $4 then f.created_at end desc, case when $3 = 'size' and $4 then f.size end asc, case when $3 = 'size' and not $4 then f.size end desc, case when $3 = 'width' and $4 then f.width end asc, case when $3 = 'width' and not $4 then f.width end desc, case when $3 = 'height' and $4 then f.height end asc, case when $3 = 'height' and not $4 then f.height end desc, case when $3 = 'original_hash' and $4 then f.original_hash end asc, case when $3 = 'original_hash' and not $4 then f.original_hash end desc, case when $3 = 'views' and $4 then f.views end asc, case when $3 = 'views' and not $4 then f.views end desc, case when $3 = 'thumbnail_views' and $4 then f.thumbnail_views end asc, case when $3 = 'thumbnail_views' and not $4 then f.thumbnail_views end desc, f.id desc offset $1 limit $2
